details.note: M1 DPO REJECTED. Evaluated on the frozen behavioral held-out set (3650 records): call_f1 fell from B0's 0.6191 to 0.1715 at step 100 and 0.0258 by step 300, with call recall collapsing 0.9722 -> 0.0965 -> 0.0131. Over-calling was eliminated (0.6425 -> 0.0034) and clarification and unsupported accuracy improved sharply (0.10 -> 0.92 and 0.013 -> 0.62), so the run worked as specified, but on the promotion metric it is a regression that degrades monotonically from the first measured checkpoint. The preference data is real, balanced and held-out-disjoint; the failure is the starting point. B0 recalls 97% of gold CALLs and 1.3% of UNSUPPORTEDs, so every signal that moves it off always-call reduces call recall.
